spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.setupSteps:
Spotify allows at most 5 users per developer app, so every user uses their own (free) app:
1. Open the Spotify developer dashboard and sign in (the app owner needs Spotify Premium).
2. Create an app, choose “Web API”.
3. Add the redirect URI below.
4. Copy the app’s Client ID here.

discord.title: Discord bot
discord.setupSteps:
Everyone uses their own bot (free):
1. Open the Discord Developer Portal and create an application (New Application).
2. Installation: set Install Link to None. Bot: turn off Public Bot.
3. OAuth2 → URL Generator: scope “bot”, permissions View Channels, Connect and Speak; open the link and invite the bot to your server.
4. Bot → Reset Token, copy the token and paste it here.
discord.tokenHint: The token is stored encrypted on this computer only and is sent only to Discord. Never share it.
discord.badTokenShape: That does not look like a bot token (three parts separated by dots). Copy it from Bot → Reset Token, not the Client Secret.
discord.notInChannel: The bot is not in a voice channel.
discord.invite: Invite the bot to another server
discord.noChannels: The bot does not see any voice channel. Invite it to your server.
discord.noMemberChannel: First join a voice channel on a server the bot is on, then click again.
discord.note: Discord hears what the player plays. Only local music and radio are sent; movies, YouTube Music and Spotify never. A muted player (or volume 0) always sends silence. The bot works only on servers you invite it to (not in private calls).
discord.followVolume: Discord volume follows the player volume
discord.silenceVideo: Silence: movies and music videos are not sent.
discord.silenceYouTube: Silence: nothing is sent while YouTube Music is open.
discord.errorBadToken: Discord rejected the token. Check that it is the bot token (Bot → Reset Token), not the Client Secret.
discord.errorNotSupported: Sending sound needs Windows 11 or Windows 10 build 20348 or newer.
discord.errorNoPermission: The bot has no permission in that channel ({0}). In Discord: channel settings → Permissions → add the bot and allow View Channel, Connect and Speak.

news.title: Notifications
news.settingsHint: News, tips and information about new versions. Dismissed and read notifications can always be found here.
news.update.title: Version {0} is available
news.update.body: A new version of the player has been downloaded and installs when you close the player.
news.update.detail: Version {0} has been downloaded from the project's official GitHub releases. It is installed the next time you close the player; your settings and history are kept. You can read what changed in the update history.
news.intro.title: Notifications are here
news.intro.body: News, tips and new versions now appear here. The bell button shows them all.
news.intro.detail: Notifications show news about the player, useful tips and new versions. They come only from the player itself and from the project's official releases. A card is shown at most three times and X dismisses it. Read and dismissed notifications can always be found under the bell button on the Home screen and in Settings → Notifications.
news.designs.title: Choose a Mini Player look
news.designs.body: All five Mini Player looks are now in Settings, with a preview.
news.designs.detail: Settings → Appearance → Mini player now shows all five looks with a preview. The change applies immediately and is kept after closing and updating the player. The same choice is still available with a right-click on the mini player.
news.eq.title: Have you tried the Equalizer?
news.eq.body: Adjust the sound with manual settings and ready-made presets.
news.eq.detail: The Equalizer in Settings → Audio lets you shape the sound by hand or with a ready-made preset. Music and radio have separate settings from movies and series.
